basics.name: Yuma Uchida
basics.label: Infrastructure Engineer / Project Manager
basics.summary: Engineer who handles both PM and technical lead roles. Covers the full range from technology selection and infrastructure design for new applications, through backend implementation and team management.

work.name: Financial Institution (undisclosed)
work.summary: Assess security risks in design documents submitted by multiple vendors and make the final go/no-go call before release.
highlights: Review design documents from 5 vendors and make the final call to prevent security incidents before release (15+ reviews).

work.name: Hospitality Service Company (undisclosed)
work.summary: Development manager for a booking management and smart lock tool for accommodations.
highlights: Leading the React rewrite, migration to ECS, and security hardening including encryption.
Built the development workflow and step-by-step procedures for support and QA staff from scratch.

work.name: Hospitality Service Company (undisclosed)
work.summary: Development of a unified booking management and smart lock control tool for accommodations.
highlights: Fully codified infrastructure with AWS CDK; automated deployment via GitHub Actions saved 12 hours of deployment work per month.
Introduced Playwright E2E testing, cutting manual testing by 20 hours per month.
Managed a multinational team of Vietnamese and Chinese engineers; made progress visible at a glance and cut executive meeting time by 60%.

work.name: Company S (Medical)
work.summary: New development and operation of a CRM (Patient Management System) and LINE Mini App for medical institutions.
highlights: PM and dev lead for a ~20-person, three-layer team, running a booking/CRM platform serving 200,000+ customers across 60 locations nationwide.
Introduced E2E testing (Playwright) and design reviews, reducing the production incident rate from 1.1% to 0.7%.
Reorganized the team and delegated authority, increasing releases of client-requested features from 5 to 8 per quarter; cut management coordination time by 6 hours per month.

work.name: Company S (Franchise)
work.summary: Development and maintenance of a core business system (Inventory, Estimation, Ordering, Construction Management) for a franchise headquarters and its franchisees.
highlights: Owned an integrated system for inventory, quotes, ordering, and construction management, from client interviews through operations.
Built a tablet feature for presenting multiple quote options on the spot, raising the same-day order rate by 5%.
Built production infrastructure on AWS (ECS, Lightsail) with CI/CD on CircleCI; upgraded Laravel from 6 to 10 in stages.

work.name: Canon Inc.
work.summary: Research and development of fuser materials for laser printers. Achieved a 10% reduction in text blur and degradation through material optimization. Transitioned to software engineering in September 2016.
